gauges.name: pipeline_status
gauges.description: 1 for the pipeline's current status label, 0 for the others.

gauges.name: pipeline_data_age_seconds
gauges.description: Seconds since the table last received a write that changed data.

gauges.name: pipeline_slo_breach
gauges.description: 1 when data age exceeds the registry freshness SLO.

gauges.name: job_definition_drift
gauges.description: 1 when the deployed job differs from its Git definition, or exists only in the workspace.

gauges.name: schema_contract_violations
gauges.description: Count of contract violations on a governed table.

gauges.name: agent_claims_contradicted
gauges.description: Claims in the latest agent review that the evidence contradicts.

gauges.name: databricks_job_duration_seconds
gauges.description: Published by the Databricks exporter. Do not republish.

gauges.name: databricks_job_failures_total
gauges.description: Published by the Databricks exporter. Do not republish.

gauges.name: pipeline_dq_pass_ratio
gauges.description: Share of data-quality checks passing. The DQ suite has not landed.

gauges.name: pipeline_cost_usd_daily
gauges.description: Daily compute cost per pipeline. No priced cost source is wired into the platform yet.
